Dialogs.Dialog: (Not here... What am I even doing...)
If you're looking for Takane, she went to the courts by herself a minute ago.
Um, you're the one from the other day...
I don't know if I should say this, but Takane was crying when she was at Dixie's with us.
She went to the courts, right？ Thank you！
What are you doing... out here？
I was remembering the day we first met here...
I remember... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you were practicing serves alone, right？
Yes... If I hadn't met you that day, I wonder what would have become of me...
I'd surely still be the way I was back then, right？
It was a hot day... You were lugging that big kettle all alone, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes... From now on, the girls on the team will help, though...
But if I hadn't met you that day...
You were sweeping up leaves all by yourself, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
From now on, the girls on the team will help, though...
It was a cold day... You were cleaning the clubroom for me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes, imagining what kind of person was coming...
What kind of person was it？
At that time, I had a strange feeling when I saw you. I still remember it.
Yes. Like everything was going to get better from that day on.
And it really did. Even now, it feels like a dream...
Even so... I think I ran away after all.
When everyone asked about us... I got scared.
I've changed so much since the time I met you...
You've been kind to me ever since the day we met, so...
I always wondered if it was just me, and I was never sure...
But even if you hated me for it,
I think I at least had to tell you how I feel.
No matter what I do, I can't stop thinking of you...
It is as if I can't control myself anymore and I'm so afraid...
I love you so much that it makes me want to cry.
So I want you to love me back, and...
I want you to say it too: "Manaka's my girlfriend"...
Yeah. I've wanted to say that for a long time too.
Sorry, if I'd said it sooner...
It's okay... It's okay, because starting today, we're...
Right... Oh no, I'm getting nervous...
Is that... something we shouldn't do？
I'm sure we'll know if we try, right？
It seems it was something we shouldn't do after all...
Because... from now on, I don't think I'll be able to find anything else that can give me the same feeling of happiness...
I love you... I really love you.
I just can't see you that way...
I like you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, but I don't think it's the same kind of like.
Don't apologize... I don't want to trouble you. I love you, so I don't want to make you look like that.
Let's be friends. Closer than before.
That way, I can keep loving you forever.
Wait a sec... I know where this is going...
Hey, we're going for ramen！ Ramen！
I'm sorry... But I want to be alone with him.
Huh!? So you two really are...
Ah, y-yes... Then let's go that way！
For real～!? Say it ain't so, Takane-chan～！
What's gotten into you all of a sudden...
Today I just really wanted to walk home with you...
I didn't want anyone getting in the way, and before I knew it, I'd said that...
Well, it's fine. You've changed, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hey, remember？ That day we met here.
I remember... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you were practicing serves alone, right？
I thought that as long as I did the right thing, it would be okay even if I had to be alone.
So even if everyone slacked off, I figured it was fine as long as I practiced.
It was a hot day... You were lugging that big kettle all alone, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
From now on, the girls on the team say they'll help.
Back then, I didn't know that with everyone, nothing feels hard at all.
You were sweeping up leaves all by yourself, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It was a cold day... You were cleaning the clubroom, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes. Because I was imagining what kind of person would come...
So cleaning the clubroom, which is always hard, wasn't hard at all.
It feels like so long ago now.
Back then, I could never have imagined who I am now...
The other night, while I was waiting for you, I thought about it the whole time.
About why I want to see you so much.
And I think it's because I've changed.
Because you taught me to just be honest.
the honest me was full of you.
How many times will our eyes meet today, when can I see you next...
I want to hear your voice, I want to be closer...
It's embarrassing, how it's all about you...
So... please let me be by your side.
I'm full of you. I love you this much... Please.
It's all about ▲高嶺＊＊▲ for me too.
For a long time now, all I think about is ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yeah... I think I feel the same way as ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Then... Do you know what I am thinking right now？
I just can't see you that way...
I can't return your feelings, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Because to me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is a precious friend.
Thank you... for telling me how you really feel.
Honestly, I kind of noticed it would be like this.
But I decided to be honest...
So this was for the best, right？
I see... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you still gave it your all...
Yes... Then from now on, we're precious friends.
I don't get it. Why a guy like him...
Hey, want to... go to the courts？
Kind of got teased there, huh？
I only told one girl I was really close with, but now the whole club seems to know about it...
I told my friend... that I was going to confess to you today...
Hey, do you remember the day we first met here？
I remember. Nobody was on the courts... and ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Yes... I was practicing my serve alone.
Everyone else was skipping practice, but I thought I had to practice anyway.
I thought that it was the right thing to do...
It was a hot day... You were lugging that big kettle all alone, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
For everyone, because it was the right thing... I got stubborn about it...
You were sweeping up leaves all by yourself, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It was a cold day... You were cleaning the clubroom, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes... Even though nobody asked me to.
I thought I had to keep it clean...
When really, I was covering up how lonely I was, how much I wanted to cry...
So when you talked to me, I was really happy.
Ever since then, I feel like you've been teaching me something.
Something simple that takes courage... and something I shouldn't cover up.
That I just need to be honest.
When I want to see you, I'll go see you.
When I'm lonely, I'll ask you to stay with me. That's what I decided.
Because I long for you this much.
I want ▲高嶺＊＊▲ by my side, always.
Me too. Because I love ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I was sure it was one-sided...
I'm happy... But I still can't quite believe it.
The club might be watching... Doesn't that bother you？
Hey, can I tell you how I honestly feel？
Once doesn't seem to be enough...
I just can't see you that way...
I don't think I can return your feelings, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
So even if we went out, I'd only end up hurting you.
Honestly, I kind of knew it would be like this.
So just hearing how you really feel like this is enough.
I don't think I could've stood staying in a one-sided love anyway.
That's okay. Even if you told me to stop, I don't think I could.
Hey, can I start calling you by your first name？
I see... Then I'll keep it as is for a while.
Geez, no answer？ I'm calling you by your name from now on, okay？
If you don't mind, can I start calling you by your first name？
▲主人公＊▲. Let's keep getting along, okay...
I see... Okay, I'll keep it as is for a while.
Um... no answer, so that means yes？ I'm calling you by your name, then.
Hey, I've been wanting to call you by your name. What do you think？
I see, too bad... I'll keep it as is for a while.
Geez, still thinking？ ...I'm calling you by your name from now on, okay？
Um, since we're at it... would you go on a date with me this Sunday？
I see？ Okay, another time, then...
Sorry, I zoned out. A date, got it.
Um, want to go on a date this Sunday？ Would that be a bother？
Um, is it a bother after all？
Sorry, I zoned out. A date, got it.
I was hoping I could go on a date with you this Sunday...
Oh, I see... Okay, got it. Another time, then？
Sorry, I zoned out. A date, got it.
Yay, I'm so happy. I'm counting on you, then？
▲主人公＊▲. From now on... let's keep getting along.
▲主人公＊▲. From now on, please take good care of me.
▲主人公＊▲. Let's keep getting along, okay？
From now on... we'll always be together, right...？
From now on... I'll always be with you...
From now on, I'll always be with you...
